detailed_findings.finding: The coefficient extraction argument is immediate from the stated definition of Hilb_M(q) as a formal power series.
The transition to the polynomial case is valid because a polynomial in Q[q] is viewed with the same coefficients in Q[[q]], so coefficients remain dim_Q(M_m) or 0.

reason: The proof is complete and matches the lemma statement exactly. It uses only the defining formula for the Hilbert series: the coefficient of q^m in Hilb_M(q) = Σ_{m≥0} (dim_Q M_m) q^m is by definition dim_Q(M_m), which is a nonnegative integer since each graded piece is finite-dimensional. The polynomial case is an immediate specialization of the same coefficient computation, with missing degrees having coefficient 0. No undeclared citations or forbidden dependencies are used.
